name: Betina Bigglezink
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The eggs you brought were to be used in Scourge experiments to create a plagued dragonflight.  These frozen black dragon eggs would have been invaluable in their studies, and would have assuredly quickened their timetable.

Now, it is time we ended their research.

Take the frozen eggs to Betina Bigglezink outside.  She is well-learned in science and alchemy, and has produced a weapon we can use against the Scourge.  With your help, we will deal them a heavy blow.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
narrative.offerRewardText:
There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!

We'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.

I have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the Scholomance. They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.

I call the device Dawn's Gambit, because... I'm not sure if it works!

Will you find out for us?
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer! I heard you were here with some dragon eggs? Well, let's see them!

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 52 to 60, 51,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Broodling Essence
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
quests.objectiveText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.objectiveText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.
